citation: Dong L, Meng Y, Sui Z, Wang J, Wu L, Fu B. Comparison of four digital PCR platforms for accurate quantification of DNA copy number of a certified plasmid DNA reference material. Sci Rep 2015;5:13174
what_it_anchors: the Poisson model that converts a positive-partition fraction to copies per partition, measured against four instruments' own reported lambda: 60 replicates, |lambda_poisson - lambda_reported| <= 0.005 at lambda 1.44-1.60
claim: Tables S5-S8 print positive and negative partition counts per replicate; recomputing lambda = -ln(neg/total) reproduces each platform's printed mean copies/partition and Table 2's lambda (1.56/1.54/1.54/1.51)
claim_kind: measured model-vs-observation residual; NOT a detection limit

citation: Digital PCR Validation for Characterization of Quantitative Reference Material of Escherichia coli O157:H7 Genomic DNA. Methods Protoc 2024;7(6):94
what_it_anchors: a SEVEN-assay ddPCR panel measured on one gravimetric dilution series: 105 replicate copy-number measurements at five levels, with per-assay LoD and working range
claim: Tables S1-S7 give three replicate days x three replicates at five levels per gene; Table 4 r2 is 0.99892-0.99980 for all seven assays; the paper sets LoD 0.27 copies/uL (rfbE 0.17) and working range 6.6-7900 copies/uL
claim_kind: measured multi-assay dilution series; per-level means deliberately NOT landed (3 of 105 rows lost a replicate in the PDF)

citation: Cheng LY, Haydu LE, Song P, Nie J, Tetzlaff MT, Kwong LN, Gershenwald JE, Davies MA, Zhang DY. High Sensitivity Sanger Sequencing Detection of BRAF Mutations in Metastatic Melanoma FFPE Tissue Specimens. Sci Rep 2021;11:9049
what_it_anchors: a MEASURED Sanger lower bound for variant allele fraction, reported per sample and tied to a named enrichment-plus-caller pipeline, replacing a textbook 20% restatement
claim: Table S3 gives BDA VAF for 23 repaired FFPE specimens; the lowest positive V600E call is 0.20% (sample 129533); the authors state a 0.1% VAF reference-material LoD and <=0.5% for six non-V600E spike-ins
claim_kind: measured VAF calls with a bound ('<0.1') preserved; the floor belongs to BDA+VarTrace, NOT to population Sanger alone

citation: Inter-laboratory comparison of eleven quantitative or digital PCR assays for detection of proviral bovine leukemia virus
what_it_anchors: the closest thing located to a multi-assay dPCR comparison corpus: 11 assays x 44 blinded samples with a pairwise agreement matrix
claim: Table 2 per-sample per-assay copy numbers; prose reports ddPCR assay 6 detecting 32 of 43 positives (DxSn 74%) with kappa 0.396; it is a diagnostic-concordance comparison, NOT a LoB/LoD validation panel
claim_kind: measured concordance only; NO LoB, NO LoD, NO dilution series - recorded as a corpus NEGATIVE
